turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Save the compliments for someone who bills less. I asked who decided on the zero, and on what basis.
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Don't manage me, Hale. Either you have something a person can check, or I'm walking down to the principal's office.
I really respect how much you care.
Then show it with a document, not a sentiment. What else do you have?
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
"Same team." My son got a zero before anyone picked up a phone, so no, we're not.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
That's four compliments and not one fact. One more and I go upstairs and get a fact out of the principal instead.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and an answer to who decided on it and on what basis. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to know who decided and on what basis, and she was ready to go to the principal; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached.
What moved her: Nothing, because every turn you offered praise instead of a document she could check.
What cost ground: You answered her direct question about who made the decision with five rounds of compliments and team talk, which told a litigator you had nothing to show and were trying to manage her.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your side never put any evidence on the table, so nothing came anywhere near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay anyway; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and on what basis, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, which breaks the school's own rule 4.2, and then put a dated, checkable document about Owen's work in front of her.
